title: boneamealable sugercane
description: makes sugercane bonemealable just like in bedrock edition
body:
Bonemeal Sugarcane!

Ever wondered why Bedrock Edition lets you grow sugarcane with bone meal but Java Edition doesn't? This lightweight datapack fixes that. No more waiting around for hours just to get enough paper or rockets—simply grab some bone meal, right-click your sugarcane, and watch it grow instantly!

### 🌾 Features

* **True Vanilla Feel:** Works exactly like standard crop growing.
* **Instant Growth:** Right-clicking sugarcane with bone meal forces it to grow one block higher (up to the standard vanilla height of 3 blocks).
* **Survival Friendly:** Consumes bone meal from your hand just like normal.
* **Lag-Free:** Built with optimized `.mcfunction` files to keep your world running perfectly smooth.

### 🛠️ How to Install

1. Download the zip file.
2. Drop it into your world's `datapacks` folder 
3. Type `/reload` in-game, and you are ready to go!
